newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Bankar to buy out Deviza Factory.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Bankar to buy out Deviza Factory.

text.p: Hungary's Bankar financial group plans to offer to buy out forex futures trading company Deviza Factory Rt in the autumn to avoid the bureaucratic procedure of liquidation, Bankar officials said.
"Bankar group wishes to make an offer for the shares of Deviza Factory in the autumn," Bankar's Chief Executive Gabor Kovacs told a news conference on Monday.
Bankar launched Deviza Factory via a public share issue in 1994, setting it up with a limited lifetime of three years.
Kovacs said if they manage to buy 95 percent of the shares, Deviza will be merged into another Bankar company instead of being liquidated.
On the Hungarian over-the-counter market Deviza Factory shares trade at around 400,000 forints.
